scope: Conservative text-rectangle background sampling of rendered SVG on a white viewer matte. Uses declared foreground/opacity and actual sampled backgrounds; no anti-aliased text colors enter the ratio. 3:1 for displayed >=24px or bold >=18.6667px, otherwise 4.5:1, without rounding. Regions include spaces, so findings may be conservative on nonuniform backgrounds. Unknown filters/blending are unmeasured, not passing. Does not certify WCAG, glyph coverage, reading order, screen-reader access, native PowerPoint, other viewer mattes, responsive scaling or text contrast outside these rendered examples. No document colors are changed.
